title: apeStandalonePayment
description: Payment to apply to an existing order.

iKaccountIdentifier.description: The ID of the account to apply this payment to.

thirdPartyPaymentReference.description: A unique external reference provided for this order. This value will be sent back in the webhook.

endpointId.description: Endpoint ID for a unique webhook that has been created using [the webhook endpoint](https://api-docs.lsk.lightspeed.app/operation/operation-apecreatewebhookoo).

taskTtlInMs.description: Maximum time to attempt delivery of this payment to the POS. In milliseconds. The minimum value is 60000ms (1 minute).

staffId.description: The ID of the employee responsible for this payment.

deviceId.description: POS device to specifically receive this payment. If left null then all POS devices may receive the payment but only one will process it.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method code as configured by the merchant.

paymentAmount.description: The total amount of the payment without tips.

targetPrinterProfileId.description: The printer profile id to use for printing the receipt for this payment. If not provided, the default active printer profile for the business location will be used.

apeBusinessLocationId.description: The unique identifier for the business location.
